page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin note at the left, beside the lines "fuis commendavit Vegetius".

main_text.p: Militibus autem noftris, ut & nobilibus juvenibus ea aprime commendanda exercitia, quibus ad pedeftre & equeftre prælium reddantur idonei. Inter quæ præcipua sunt,quibus ad haftam vibrandum inftruuntur, curfu certant,fclopi ejaculationead metam, contendunt. Quibus addatur cursus equitum ad anulum, quem Galli appellant la bague. Potiffimùm inftrui poterunt finguli ad ficti hominis pugnam;quod exercitii genus Veget.l. 1. de re Milit.c. 11,suis commendavit Vegetius vetus campi doctor. Quando finguli tyrones defignant palum, adversus quem veluti adversarium fcuto, & clavâ, tanquam gladio, fe quisque exerceret; nunc quasi caput aut faciem peteret, nunc à lateribus minaretur, interdum contenderet poplites ac crura ferire, recederet, infultaret, infiliret, & quasi

page.notes: The margin note is printed in small type as "Veget.l. 1. de re Milit.c. 11," over four short lines; transcribed as one note. Spacing errors such as "sunt,quibus", "ejaculationead" and "finguli ad ficti" are reproduced as printed. "ficti" is read with some doubt; the long s is shown as s throughout. A faint mark at the bottom right corner is a digitiser's artefact and is left out.
